QuestInfo.name: [Morass] A Frightening Rumor 1
QuestInfo.0: It seems that man in Trueffet Square is in trouble.
QuestInfo.1: The man in Trueffet Square asks you to retrieve his Ripe Apples. You can get them from #bPowerful Gangsters#k on #bBully Blvd.#k
QuestInfo.2: You helped that man retrieve his product, but he's still reluctant to talk about what happened the day of the accident. The pottery shop lady should be more helpful.

item.0: You don't have enough #bRipe Apples#k. You can retrieve them from the #bPowerful Gangsters#k on #bBully Blvd. 1 and 2#k.
